title: Continuous Angular Control in Text-to-Image Generation via Geometric Token Encoding
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can render a photorealistic analog clock but cannot control the time it displays. Across four pretrained models, fewer than 1% of generated clocks place both hands within 6 degrees of the requested time; the models instead collapse onto visually dominant configurations such as the canonical 10:10 pose. The same failure appears when a specific fraction of a circular object is requested, where models return complete or conventionally sliced objects. We observe that these two failures share a geometric structure: both target quantities can be parameterized by angular variables. We introduce a geometric token encoding framework that conditions generation directly on these angles. Each angular component is encoded as a periodic sine-cosine feature and projected into a role-specific token embedding that is injected into the prompt before a frozen text encoder. To spatially ground these tokens without requiring localization input at inference, we introduce Stochastic Localization Relaxation (SLR), which stochastically relaxes attention supervision from component-level to object-level to unconstrained localization during training. For clocks, we additionally introduce a hand-swap preference objective that discourages assigning the correct angles to the wrong hand roles. On analog clocks our method reaches 63-78% Acc@6 degrees across evaluation methods, compared with below 1% for the baselines. On circular-fraction generation, it achieves 89.5% Acc@0.10, while maintaining 88.8% on unseen object categories and 84.9% on unseen target values, compared with roughly 20% for pretrained baselines.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出几何令牌编码与随机定位松弛方法，使文本生成图像扩散模型能够按照指定角度精确控制模拟时钟指针或圆形物体的比例，显著提升几何可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图扩散模型能够生成逼真的模拟时钟，但难以根据提示词精确控制指针显示时间；在四个预训练模型中，生成结果里两根指针与请求时间误差小于6度的比例不足1%，模型易坍缩到10:10等常见姿态。类似地，生成指定比例的圆形物体时也常输出完整或惯常切割形状。这些失败可统一视为角度几何控制不足。
AI.method: 作者提出几何令牌编码框架，将角度变量直接作为生成条件。每个角度分量被编码为周期性正弦-余弦特征，再投影为具有角色语义的令牌嵌入，并注入冻结文本编码器之前的提示中。为了在不提供推理时定位输入的情况下实现空间绑定，提出随机定位松弛（SLR），训练时逐步放松注意力监督，从部件级定位过渡到物体级定位再到无约束定位。针对时钟，还设计指针交换偏好目标，避免正确角度被错误地分配给时针或分针。
AI.result: 在模拟时钟任务上，该方法在多种评估方式下达到63%至78%的Acc@6度，而基线低于1%。在圆形比例生成任务上达到89.5%的Acc@0.10；在未见过的物体类别上保持88.8%准确率，在未见目标值上保持84.9%，均显著优于预训练基线约20%的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，将连续几何属性显式参数化为角度并直接编码到文本条件中，可以有效提升扩散模型对细粒度空间几何的可控生成能力；SLR进一步使模型在不需要推理时位置输入的情况下学习到部件与对象的空间关系。

title: Adaptive Residual Quantization for Memory-Efficient Temporal Action Segmentation
summary: Temporal action segmentation (TAS) is commonly trained on large banks of pre-extracted frame features, but storing and replaying those features becomes a practical bottleneck for long-form video, especially in incremental TAS where past-task data must remain available to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Recent TAS replay and condensation methods reduce this burden, but they rely on dense frame-wise annotations and allocate storage through fixed segment-level structures, limiting their flexibility for long procedural videos whose frame complexity varies substantially over time. We introduce Adaptive Residual-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder (ARQ-VAE), a compact and label-free memory representation for TAS features that learns a discrete residual quantization of frame-level video features and then adaptively truncates the residual chain on a per-frame basis, retaining only the residual prefix that best reconstructs each frame feature. This yields a practical compact feature memory that does not depend on frame-wise labels and can therefore support multiple TAS settings with the same stored representation, while a lightweight fine-tuning stage further improves reconstruction quality for the truncated codes that are actually retained. Across standard TAS benchmarks, ARQ-VAE achieves a substantially improved storage-performance trade-off over prior replay and condensation baselines. On Breakfast, our final representation reduces training-set storage from 28 GB for the original I3D feature bank to 10 MB while retaining strong downstream segmentation performance; with ASFormer, it achieves 71.5 Edit and 51.2 F1@50 in the supervised setting. We further show that the same label-free memory remains effective for incremental and unsupervised TAS. We position ARQ-VAE as a practical memory representation for TAS and a promising direction for broader dataset condensation applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ARQ-VAE，一种用于时序动作分割的无标签、自适应残差量化特征记忆，通过保留每帧最佳重建残差前缀，实现从 28 GB 到 10 MB 的显著压缩，并在监督、增量和无监督设置中保持良好性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频时序动作分割常依赖大规模预提取帧特征库，存储和回放成为瓶颈；增量场景中还需保留历史任务数据以缓解灾难性遗忘。现有回放或数据浓缩方法依赖密集帧级标注，并按固定分段结构分配存储，难以适应复杂帧内容随时间变化显著的长程序化视频。
AI.method: 提出 Adaptive Residual-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder（ARQ-VAE），学习帧级视频特征的离散残差量化表示，并在每帧基础上自适应截断残差链，仅保留最能重建该帧特征的残差前缀。该表示不依赖帧级标签，支持多种 TAS 设置共享同一存储；再通过轻量微调提升所保留截断编码的重建质量。
AI.result: 在标准 TAS 基准上，ARQ-VAE 相比以往回放和数据浓缩基线显著改善存储与性能之间的权衡。在 Breakfast 数据集上，将原始 I3D 特征库的训练集存储从 28 GB 降至 10 MB，并保持强下游分割性能；结合 ASFormer 在监督设置下达到 71.5 Edit 和 51.2 F1@50。相同的无标签记忆在增量 TAS 和无监督 TAS 中同样有效。
AI.conclusion: ARQ-VAE 为时序动作分割提供了一种实用、紧凑且标签自由的特征记忆方案，不仅缓解长视频特征存储与回放瓶颈，也为更广泛的数据集浓缩应用提供了有前景的方向。

title: RF3DGS: Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Priors
summary: 3D reflection removal is crucial in applications demanding high-fidelity visualization, such as museum exhibitions. In this work, we propose Reflection-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting (RF3DGS), a novel method for superior reflection removal. RF3DGS exclusively leverages a widely-adopted photometric prior for reflection removal: that the minimum pixel intensity across multi-view images corresponding to the same 3D point strongly correlates with reflection-free information. However, generalizing this principle to a 3D Gaussian Splatting within a multi-view context is non-trivial. To address this, RF3DGS first optimizes a vanilla 3DGS model using a geometric prior to estimate a coarse, reflection-free depth map for each view. Leveraging these depth maps and photometric prior, a 3D warping process aggregates reflection-free information from auxiliary views to construct a clean transmission pseudo-label for a given reference view. This pseudo-label provides a robust self-supervised signal for optimization. We further introduce an Adaptive Twin Rendering (ATR) loss to synergistically utilize this pseudo-label while preserving high-frequency details from the original, reflection-degraded images. By adeptly fusing these internal 3D self-priors with the ATR loss, RF3DGS demonstrates state-of-the-art reflection removal performance across both synthetic and real-world scenarios. Furthermore, we establish the first 3D reflection removal benchmark, based on the Unity rendering engine, for rigorous quantitative evaluation.
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Joint first authors: Qiang Wen, Guotao Meng, and Junhong Ruan

AI.tldr: 提出 RF3DGS，将 3D Gaussian Splatting 与多视图光度先验、几何深度先验和 3D 重投影伪标签结合，实现高质量 3D 反射去除，并建立首个基于 Unity 的 3D 反射去除评测基准。
AI.motivation: 博物馆展览等高保真可视化场景需要去除图像或三维渲染中的镜面反射干扰；传统反射去除多在 2D 或单视图框架中进行，难以直接推广到三维重建场景，且需要避免过度平滑并保留高频细节。
AI.method: RF3DGS 首先使用几何先验优化基础 3DGS 模型，估计各视图的粗略无反射深度图；随后基于多视图光度先验，即同一 3D 点在不同视图中的最小像素强度与无反射透射信息高度相关，利用深度图进行 3D 重投影，从辅助视图聚合无反射信息，为参考视图构造干净的透射伪标签；再提出 Adaptive Twin Rendering loss，将自监督伪标签与原始带反射图像融合，在去除反射的同时保留高频细节。
AI.result: 在合成和真实场景中均取得优于现有方法的反射去除性能，并通过 Unity 渲染引擎建立首个 3D 反射去除定量评测基准，为系统评估提供支持。
AI.conclusion: 将多视图光度先验与 3DGS 几何建模结合，并通过 3D warping 生成自监督透射伪标签，是 RF3DGS 实现鲁棒 3D 反射去除的核心；该工作同时推动了 3D 反射去除基准的发展。

title: Spatial-Spectral Coupling as Attention: Scaling Shape Correspondence to High-Resolution Surfaces
summary: Establishing dense correspondence between high-resolution 3D shapes remains challenging due to the spatial--spectral coupling at the core of many functional-map methods, which grows quadratically with mesh resolution. We observe that this coupling is equivalent to a scaled dot-product attention formulation, with learned descriptors serving as queries and keys and spectral basis functions as values. This connection makes efficient attention implementations directly applicable to shape matching and an effective mechanism for scaling spatial-spectral coupling. We show that optimized quadratic attention implementations can scale modern deep functional map pipelines to large mesh sizes, improving both runtime and memory consumption, while sub-quadratic methods introduce errors, particularly for non-isometric shape pairs, where an exact coupling proves most necessary. These insights motivate \textit{Geo-FlashAttention}, which restricts the exact softmax to geometry-selected surface patches and achieves near-linear empirical scaling while preserving correspondence accuracy of exact implementations. Across six standard benchmarks and three functional-map pipelines, rigorous analysis shows that efficient couplings preserve correspondence accuracy. At $60k$ vertices, these insights reduce peak training memory from 106.08 to 5.67\,GiB, with Geo-FlashAttention being $1.5\times$ faster per training step than FlashAttention. This enables end-to-end learning for correspondence problems on large meshes such as cortical surfaces, where high resolution is required to preserve disease-relevant intricacies of the surface geometry. AI.tldr: 论文提出将函数映射中的空间—谱耦合等价为缩放点积注意力，并用 Geo-FlashAttention 在大网格高分辨率三维形状对应任务中实现近线性显存与计算扩展，同时保持接近精确耦合的对应精度。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率三维形状间的稠密对应在函数映射方法中受制于空间—谱耦合，其成本随网格规模二次增长；现有高效注意力中的近似或亚二次策略可能在非等距匹配等关键场景引入误差，因此需要既高效又保留精确耦合性质的方法。
AI.method: 作者发现函数映射的空间—谱耦合可改写为缩放点积注意力：学习描述子作为 query/key，谱基函数作为 value；由此引入优化的精确二次注意力实现来扩展深度函数映射流水线，并进一步提出 Geo-FlashAttention，根据几何信息选择局部表面 patch 进行精确 softmax 计算，以降低全局耦合开销。
AI.result: 在六个标准基准和三种函数映射流水线上的实验表明，高效耦合能保持对应精度；在 60k 顶点网格上，训练峰值显存从 106.08 GiB 降至 5.67 GiB，Geo-FlashAttention 每个训练步骤比 FlashAttention 快 1.5 倍，并支持皮层表面等大规模高分辨率网格的端到端对应学习。
AI.conclusion: 将空间—谱耦合与注意力机制建立联系，使高效注意力可直接用于三维形状匹配；Geo-FlashAttention 在显著降低内存和运行成本的同时保留了高分辨率、非等距形状对应所需的精确耦合能力，为大规模三维几何分析提供了可行路径。
